synthesis.appearance_hypotheses: Repeated model-generated captions included a colorful cloud with a rainbow colored pattern (3 frames); a black and green rose with a white outline (2 frames); a blue and white flower (2 frames). Frequent prompt-relative hypotheses: light: soft diffuse lighting (25/32 frames); material: smooth digital surfaces (32/32 frames); medium: a 3D render (24/32 frames); setting: an abstract composition (29/32 frames); tone: a tense ominous image (24/32 frames).
synthesis.audio_control: 16 matched programme-versus-silence comparisons had median hue divergence 0.000 bits. Differences may also reflect unseeded projectM rendering or feedback evolution, not just musical response.

synthesis.interpretation_limits: PixelCue features quantify sampled rasters, not subjective quality or creative intention. BLIP captions, CLIP prompts and VLM tags are fallible per-frame hypotheses. Still frames cannot establish flash safety or perceived motion quality. Only an authenticated artist-provided suite can establish behaviour on actual album audio.
synthesis.observed_effects: Across input families, colour-bars: hue divergence median 0.198 bits, texture divergence median 0.729 bits across 8 observed pairs; cover-lyrics: hue divergence median 0.072 bits, texture divergence median 0.300 bits across 8 observed pairs; grid-rings: hue divergence median 0.020 bits, texture divergence median 0.296 bits across 8 observed pairs; text-card: hue divergence median unavailable bits, texture divergence median 0.203 bits across 8 observed pairs.
synthesis.scope: Observed 32 paired source/output measurements across 8 declared conditions, including 2 cover/lyric conditions and output times 0, 0.5, 1.5, 3 seconds.
synthesis.temporal_behaviour: For successive captures of the same input condition, median measured texture divergence was 0.008 bits across 24 transitions.
